title: The Stepwise Informativeness Assumption: When Do Entropy Dynamics Track Reasoning Correctness in LLMs?
abstract: arXiv:2604.06192v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work uses entropy-based signals at multiple representation levels to study reasoning in large language models, but the field remains largely empirical. From a theoretical perspective, reductions in model uncertainty do not necessarily reflect progress toward correctness. In this work, we characterize when such alignment can be expected through the Stepwise Informativeness Assumption (SIA), which requires entropy-reducing reasoning-prefix extensions increase the probability assigned to valid answers in expectation. We show that next-token prediction can transfer answer-relevant information from training data to the model, but does not, by itself, guarantee alignment with correctness. Instead, we propose that this alignment depends on how the training regime couples reasoning traces to correct answers. translated_title: 步进信息性假设：熵动态何时能追踪大语言模型的推理正确性？
translated_abstract: 近期的研究使用基于熵的信号在多个表示层次上研究大语言模型的推理，但该领域在很大程度上仍停留在经验层面。从理论角度看，模型不确定性的降低并不一定反映其朝正确性的进展。在这项工作中，我们通过步进信息性假设（Stepwise Informativeness Assumption, SIA）来刻画何时可以预期这种对齐关系，该假设要求降低熵的推理前缀扩展在期望上增加分配给有效答案的概率。我们表明，下一词元预测能够将与答案相关的信息从训练数据传递到模型，但其本身并不能保证与正确性对齐。相反，我们提出这种对齐取决于训练机制如何将推理轨迹与正确答案相耦合。此外，我们假设了这一现象的可观测特征，并刻画了其预期的失效情形。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出步进信息性假设（SIA），从理论上刻画了熵降低何时能真实反映大语言模型推理的正确性进展，并指出这种对齐取决于训练机制将推理轨迹与正确答案耦合的方式，同时给出了该现象的可观测特征和失效情形。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Stepwise Informativeness Assumption (SIA) to theoretically characterize when entropy reduction reliably tracks reasoning correctness in LLMs, showing that such alignment depends on how the training regime couples reasoning traces to correct answers, and identifying observable signatures and expected failure regimes of this phenomenon.
